Layer Mixer

    Start empty?

    This removes all your paints, your saved recipes and the current recipe from this browser. It cannot be undone. Save first if you want to keep them.

    How it works

    Mix

    1. Pick a brand and a range on the left. Star a brand to keep it on top, drag stars to reorder.
    2. Click paints from dark to light. They fill the recipe from Deep shadow to Top highlight.
    3. Click a layer in the recipe to change it.

    Preview

    • Drag on the shape to move the light. Double-click resets it.
    • Change the shape, switch Smooth / Stepped, set the light strength with .

    Recipes

    • Name a recipe and save it, or start from an example.
    • Copy recipe puts it on the clipboard as text.
    • Paints needed lists what the recipe uses.

    My paints

    • Mark the paints you own: click, drag across, or click a row name.
    • Mine shows only your paints. Paints you lack are highlighted in Paints needed.
    • Save writes your paints and recipes to a file, Load reads it back. Save as picks a new file.

    Keyboard

    • Arrow keys move through the brand list, F stars a brand, Alt + arrows reorders stars.
    • Arrow keys on the shape move the light. Enter on a row name marks the whole row in My paints.
